template.admin_help: Website templates decide how the whole wiki looks. Templates of code come with plugins and are references; templates of data can be copied and changed here. Which template applies is chosen in the settings of the site and of categories.
template.code_note: A template of code cannot be changed or copied here.
template.used_for_site: {name} is now the template of the site.
template.delete_confirm: Move the template {name} to the trash?
template.purge_confirm: Delete the template {name} permanently? This cannot be undone.
template.import_help: A file exported from a wiki. It is checked like every change.
template.not_json: The file is not a template file (JSON).
template.name: Name
template.design_text_help: The template as JSON: rows of areas with positions, design values and the views for tablet and phone. Every change is checked against the same limits as on saving.
template.no_problems: No problems: the template can be saved.
perm.core.template.design_help: Create, copy, import, change and delete templates of data (template designer).
limit.core.template.count.help: How many templates of data can be stored (without the trash).
limit.core.template.fonts.help: How many fonts can be uploaded for templates at most.
limit.core.template.font_kb.help: How large one uploaded font file (WOFF2, WOFF, TTF or OTF) may be.
limit.core.template.font_upload_kb.help: How large the request that uploads a font may be: all its files as base64, about a third more than the files. Keep it above the size of the files of a font.
limit.core.template.versions.help: How many earlier versions of a template of data are kept; older ones are removed.
template.versions_help: Take an earlier version into the text above; it becomes a new version when you save.
template.version_taken: Version {version} is in the text. Save to use it.
template.limit_view: {view} (from {px} px): the content needs at least {rem} rem.
template.limit_blocks: An area beside others is between {min} and {max} rem wide.
template.limit_counts: At most {rows} rows, {per_row} areas per row, {blocks} areas and {positions} positions.
template.limit_contrast: Contrast at least {text}:1 for text, {ui}:1 for controls and focus.
template.d_after_help: Separated by commas, for example content-bottom.
template.d_content_note: The content of the page is always the main landmark and takes the rest of its row.
template.d_content_width: Width of rows with limited width (rem)
template.d_contrast_help: Every pair of colours shown together is checked. When a pair has too little contrast, take the suggested colour: it is the nearest one that passes.
template.d_delete_row: Delete the row {name} with its areas?
template.d_fit_help: The area takes the room its content needs and gets narrower down to its minimum when the row is full.
template.d_hint_menu: {view}: {name} shows {fit} of {all} entries on one line; {more} go to the next line or under More.
template.d_hint_menu_ok: {view}: all {all} entries of {name} fit on one line.
template.d_hint_overflow: {view}: the content of {name} needs {need} px, the area has {have} px. Make it wider or let it go below the others.
template.d_hints_none: Everything has room in this view.
template.d_id_help: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; starts with a letter.
template.d_keep_content: The content of the page cannot be removed; move it to another row instead.
template.d_kind_help: An area with positions takes menus and blocks there; exactly one area is the content of the page.
template.d_leave: The template has changes that are not saved. Leave without saving?
template.d_logo_help: Address of a picture of the wiki (/api/v1/files/…); empty: the name of the wiki.
template.d_pair_bad: {name}: {value}:1 – too little, at least {min}:1 is needed.
template.d_positions_help: Names of the positions this area offers, separated by commas. Menus and blocks are placed there.
template.d_positions_room: Its {n} positions side by side need at least {need} rem.
template.d_preview_help: The wiki itself with this design, as you see it with your permissions. Nothing is saved until you save.
template.d_preview_page_help: An address of this wiki, for example / or /search.
template.d_preview_wait: The preview follows as soon as all values have a valid form.
template.d_role_help: Several navigations or side columns need different labels.
template.d_room_bad: {view}: needs {need} rem, but there are only {have} rem.
template.d_rowrole_help: Rows of the header must be above the content, rows of the footer below it; adjacent rows form one landmark.
template.d_select: Choose a row or an area in the structure.
template.d_sticky: Header stays on top when scrolling
template.d_sticky_help: Only while it takes at most {vh} % of the height of the window; else it scrolls with the page, so it never hides the content.
template.d_structure_help: Rows from top to bottom, areas side by side. Choose one to change it; the arrows move it.
template.d_text_first: The text is not a complete design yet. Correct it first.
template.d_desktop_drawer: Also on the desktop in a drawer: {name}
template.d_desktop_drawer_help: The menu as a button with a drawer ("burger menu") also on the desktop. What is in a drawer here is in one on tablet and phone too.
template.d_css_help: Applies to the whole wiki while this template is used. Not allowed: @import, url() other than files of the wiki (/api/v1/files/… or /api/v1/media/ID/view), image-set(), escapes with a backslash, anything that runs. Own CSS can make the wiki less accessible: check contrast and focus.
template.d_css_off: Own CSS is switched off. The administration switches it on under Settings (Own CSS in templates).
template.d_fold: Open and close on the phone
template.d_fold_help: On the phone each area of this footer shows only its name; a tap opens it. Every area needs a name.
template.d_sticky_col_help: The side column stays beside the content; when it is higher than the window it scrolls in itself.
template.d_collapsible_help: A button hides and shows the side column; the browser keeps the choice.
template.d_remove_pos: The position {positions} is no longer in the template. These building blocks stand there by default and are then no longer shown until they get another place: {blocks}.
template.d_widths_help: Drag the edge of an area, or use the arrow keys on it (Page up/down: 4 rem).
template.d_shrink: The sticky header gets lower while scrolling
template.d_shrink_help: Once the page is scrolled, the header takes less room. Makes the header sticky.
template.d_hide: The sticky header goes away while scrolling down
template.d_hide_help: It comes back when scrolling up and whenever the keyboard focus is in it. Makes the header sticky.
template.d_print_help: Header, footer, side columns and buttons are left out when printing.
template.rights_help: Who of the people allowed to design templates may change and manage this template. Nobody named: all of them. Without the permission to design templates, these rights give nothing.
template.rights_edit_help: Change the design and the name. Empty: everybody who manages it (or all designers if nobody is named at all).
template.rights_manage_help: Also its rights, the trash and its own CSS. Empty: everybody who may change it.
template.d_css_manage: Only those who manage this template may change its own CSS.
template.fonts_help: Upload a font as one or more files: WOFF2, WOFF, TTF or OTF, for example regular, bold and italic, or one variable font with all weights. The wiki serves the files unchanged from itself, never from elsewhere. Then choose the font in the designer under Type.
template.font_file_help: Up to 8 files of the same font. Weight and style are taken from the file names; change them below if needed. One font per file, no collection (TTC).
template.font_note_help: For example where the font comes from. Needed for another license: name it and where the right to use the font on the web comes from.
template.font_confirm: I confirm that this font may be used on this website (embedded on the web).
template.d_font_help: Own fonts are uploaded under Templates → Own fonts.
template.d_width_help_block: 0: the rest of the row; otherwise {min} to {max} rem.
template.limit_size: A design has at most {kb} KB.
